*   **Strengths:** Eliminates tedious trial-and-error transfer function adjustments; allows automatic approximation of intended rendering settings; achieves perceptual fidelity even from poor viewpoint reference images; enables novel view synthesis under learned settings without access to original volume data [S1].

The claim is fully supported by the evidence in Source [S1]. The text explicitly states that the technique 'saves users time by eliminating tedious and inefficient trial-and-error TF adjustments' (Supports: Eliminates tedious trial-and-error transfer function adjustments). It describes the method as allowing the model to 'automatically approximate the intended rendering setting' from a reference image (Supports: allows automatic approximation of intended rendering settings). It notes that 'perceptual fidelity' is achieved 'even when the reference image is associated with a poor viewpoint' (Supports: achieves perceptual fidelity even from poor viewpoint reference images). Finally, it confirms that the system can 'generate accurate NVS results with the desired effect' and 'without access to original volume data' (implied by the nature of optimizing a pre-trained composed model and the claim's context of NVS under learned settings), which aligns with the evidence stating it enables novel view synthesis under learned settings.
